title: Measuring Where Intent Gets Lost in Agentic Smart Contract Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2610.37830v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents can now write software from a plain-English description, but code that runs is not the same as code that does what was asked. This gap matters most for smart contracts, the programs behind Web3 applications that move money on a blockchain and cannot be fixed once deployed. We ask how to check whether an AI-written contract behaves as it should, and where the requested behavior gets lost.   We design an evaluation built on execution rather than opinion. We replay the same transactions on an AI-written contract and on the original it should reproduce and measure how often they agree. We test every grading tool on planted mistakes, compare against an answer key written without the description, and audit our own scorer until known wrong answers cannot pass. Common methods, such as AI judges and standard analysis tools, miss obvious mistakes, and scoring choices matter too. Checking only the functions every system includes hid about

translated_title: 度量智能体式智能合约合成中意图在何处丢失
translated_abstract: AI智能体现在可以根据纯英文描述编写软件，但能够运行的代码并不等于能完成预期任务的代码。这一差距对智能合约最为关键——智能合约是Web3应用背后的程序，在区块链上转移资金，且一旦部署就无法修复。我们要探讨的是：如何检验AI编写的合约是否按预期运行，以及所请求的行为在何处丢失。我们设计了一套基于执行而非主观判断的评估方法。我们在AI编写的合约和它应当复现的原始合约上重放相同的交易，并测量两者的一致频率。我们在植入的错误上测试每一个评分工具，与不依赖原始描述编写的标准答案进行对比，并审计我们自己的评分器，直到已知的错误答案无法通过评估。常见方法，如AI裁判和标准分析工具，会漏掉明显的错误，评分方式的选择同样重要。仅检查所有系统都包含的函数会隐藏大约……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于执行对比的智能合约评估方法，通过在AI生成的合约与原始合约上重放相同交易来度量用户意图丢失的程度，发现AI裁判等常见评分方法会漏掉明显的错误。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an execution-based evaluation that replays identical transactions on AI-generated smart contracts and their originals to measure where user intent gets lost, finding that common scoring methods such as AI judges miss obvious mistakes.
